note: Built-in part properties. Add your own in another layer (see bruceworx/partprops.py) instead of editing this file.

properties.name: PartNumber
properties.doc: Part number without revision; set by the vault

properties.name: Revision
properties.doc: Current revision (01, 02 ... before release; A, B ... after); set by the vault

properties.name: LifecycleState
properties.doc: Lifecycle state (WIP, In Review, Released, Obsolete); set by the vault

properties.name: ItemType
properties.doc: What the vault treats this as

properties.name: MaterialName
properties.doc: Name of the material assigned to the bodies

properties.name: Mass
properties.doc: Volume times material density, summed over the bodies

properties.name: MeasuredMass
properties.doc: Mass you weighed; beats DatasheetMass and volume times density (centre of mass stays the shape's centroid, inertia scales to this mass)

properties.name: DatasheetMass
properties.doc: Mass from the datasheet, used when no MeasuredMass is typed and instead of volume times density

properties.name: Vendor
properties.doc: Supplier, for COTS and purchased parts

properties.name: QuantityUnit
properties.doc: Unit the BOM counts this item in: empty for a count (each), m for wires, pipes and hoses (ROU-04)

properties.name: QuantityPer
properties.doc: Quantity of the unit per occurrence: 1 for a counted part, the length in metres of a routed item
